data.one_liner: Generate ARB localization files from CSV files.
data.what_it_does: A Dart tool that reads localization strings from CSV files and outputs them into Flutter-compatible ARB format files. It supports ICU message syntax, plurals, selects, descriptions, and optional placeholder metadata.
use_when: You prefer managing translations in spreadsheet tools or CSV format.
You want to feed generated ARB files into the official Flutter intl localization pipeline.
avoid_when: You manage localization files directly as ARB, JSON, or YAML without a CSV intermediary.
You want a fully-featured runtime localization framework rather than just a conversion script.
strengths: Simplifies working with translators who use CSV spreadsheets.
Supports ICU placeholders, plurals, and select rules.
Compatible with the standard Flutter intl localization system.
weaknesses: Requires a separate CSV conversion step during development.
Limited to file conversion rather than full in-app runtime translation management.
data.setup_notes: Add as a dev dependency, configure settings in pubspec.yaml, and run via dart run arb_generator.

alternatives.name: slang
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a type-safe localization solution using JSON/YAML files instead of generating ARB files.

alternatives.name: easy_localization
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer loading translation files directly at runtime without code generation.
